title: Dragging a tab between two Chrome tabs running TermAl stopped working
outcome: A TermAl tab dragged from one Chrome tab (TermAl window) to another lands there again, as it did before the regression.
acceptance: Dragging a TermAl tab from one Chrome tab showing TermAl and dropping it in another Chrome tab showing TermAl moves the tab there, verified in the running app.
The commit that broke cross-Chrome-tab drag is identified, and a test that fails without the fix covers the transfer path.
Tab reordering inside one Chrome tab still works.
disposal_reason: Withdrawn by Greg, relayed by Engram::Asistant (TermAl mailbox a456e443 #118, 16:56Z), verbatim: "false alarm, mialem wersje dev i release, dziala wszystko! uff". He had a dev and a release build open at once; drag and drop between Chrome tabs works. No fix needed.
